title: Explained path, contract version 1
description: What cms:explain <url> --json prints for an answered read (GUARDRAILS 5 and 7.1): the explanation of the resolution of the URL, the content keys the answer is tagged with (PRD 9.4) and the position of the read. The PHP form is Cbox\Cms\Core\Routing\Domain\Dto\ExplainedPath, and the generated codec ExplainedPathCodecV1 writes its canonical JSON on one line: keys sorted, no whitespace.

content_keys.description: The content keys the answer is tagged with, each once and sorted: e-<entry> for an entry and n-<node> for a node, each a UUIDv7 in lowercase.

explanation.description: The explanation of the resolution, a document of path-explanation.v1.json.

read_position.description: The position of the read (PRD 8.4): the xmin of its snapshot, in decimal; the read saw every changeset whose position is below it.
